text:
TAVALLUD AYYOMINGIZ MUBORAK!

Qarshi shahri 1-son ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internat direktori Oripova Nozima Shuxratovnaning tavallud kuni munosabati bilan u kishining samarali mehnat faoliyatini aks ettiruvchi qisqa videolavha e’tiboringizga havola etilmoqda.

Ushbu videolavhada fidoyi rahbarning ta’lim-tarbiya rivoji yo‘lidagi sa’y-harakatlari, tashabbuslari va erishilgan yutuqlari qisqacha o‘z aksini topgan.

Nozima Shuxratovnaga mustahkam sog‘liq, oilaviy xotirjamlik, mas’uliyatli faoliyatlarida ulkan muvaffaqiyatlar va yangi zafarlar tilaymiz!
text_en:
HAPPY BIRTHDAY!

On the occasion of the birthday of Oripova Nozima Shukhratovna, director of specialized boarding school No. 1, Karshi city, a short video showing her effective work is brought to your attention.

In this video, the efforts, initiatives and achievements of the selfless leader in the field of educational development are briefly reflected.

We wish Nozima Shukhratovna good health, family peace, great success and new victories in her responsible activities!

text:
🌟 ECO PULSE — EKOLOGIYA, SALOMATLIK VA TEXNOLOGIYA BIR PLATFORMADA! 🌱

Qarshi shahar 1-son ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internatining 11-sinf o‘quvchisi Abdivayitov Asadbek tomonidan ekologiya va zamonaviy texnologiyalar uyg‘unligini o‘zida mujassam etgan EcoPulse loyihasiga asos solindi.

Atrof-muhit holati inson salomatligiga bevosita ta’sir ko‘rsatadi. Biz yashayotgan yoki borishni rejalashtirayotgan hududdagi havo sifati qanday? Ekologik vaziyat salomatligimiz uchun qanchalik qulay? Bu kabi savollarga javob topishda Eco Pulse platformasi yordam beradi.

🤝 Eco Pulse platformasining asosiy imkoniyatlari:
⛅️ Havo sifati va ob-havo monitoringi
O‘zbekistonning turli hududlaridagi havo sifati va ob-havo ko‘rsatkichlarini kuzatish imkoniyati.

🏥 Shifoxonalar va ekologik xarita
O‘zbekiston hududidagi shifoxonalar joylashuvini interaktiv xaritada ko‘rish, tanlangan hududning sun’iy yo‘ldosh ma’lumotlari asosida havo sifati va ekologik holati bilan tanishish imkoniyati.

🌐 Global ekologik yangiliklar
Dunyo bo‘ylab sodir bo‘layotgan ekologik hodisalar va yangiliklardan xabardor bo‘lish.

🌳 Daraxt ekish tashabbusi
Ekologik hamjamiyatga qo‘shilish, daraxt ekish tashabbuslarida ishtirok etish va yashil kelajakni yaratishga o‘z hissasini qo‘shish.

🌪 Tabiiy ofatlar monitoringi
Dovullar, o‘rmon yong‘inlari va kuchli bo‘ronlarni real vaqt tahlillari, statistik ma’lumotlar hamda reytinglar orqali kuzatish.

✔️ Eng muhimi, platformaning barcha imkoniyatlaridan mutlaqo bepul foydalanish mumkin!

🌿 Eco Pulse — toza havo, sog‘lom hayot va yashil kelajak sari!

🌐 Veb-sayt: https://eco-pulsy-5of6.onrender.com/
🚀 Telegram kanal: https://t.me/Eco_Pulse_AQI

Yosh avlodning zamonaviy bilim va texnologiyalardan foydalangan holda jamiyat uchun foydali loyihalar yaratishi tahsinga sazovor. Abdivayitov Asadbekning ushbu tashabbusi yoshlarning innovatsion salohiyati va ekologik muammolarga befarq emasligini namoyon etadi.

Abdivayitov Asadbekka kelgusidagi izlanishlari va yangi loyihalarida ulkan muvaffaqiyatlar tilaymiz!

🌎 Tabiatni asrash — salomatligimizni asrash demakdir!
text_en:
🌟 ECO PULSE — ECOLOGY, HEALTH AND TECHNOLOGY ON ONE PLATFORM! 🌱

The EcoPulse project, which combines ecology and modern technologies, was founded by Abdivayitov Asadbek, an 11th-grade student of Karshi city specialized boarding school No. 1.

The state of the environment directly affects human health. What is the air quality like in the area where we live or plan to visit? How favorable is the ecological situation for our health? The Eco Pulse platform helps to find answers to such questions.

🤝 The main capabilities of the Eco Pulse platform:
⛅️ Air quality and weather monitoring
Ability to monitor air quality and weather indicators in different regions of Uzbekistan.

🏥 Hospitals and ecological map
It is possible to see the location of hospitals in the territory of Uzbekistan on an interactive map, to get acquainted with the air quality and environmental condition of the selected area based on satellite data.

🌐 Global environmental news
To be aware of environmental events and news happening around the world.

🌳 Tree planting initiative
Join the environmental community, participate in tree planting initiatives and contribute to a greener future.

🌪 Monitoring of natural disasters
Track hurricanes, wildfires and severe storms with real-time analysis, statistics and ratings.
✔️ Most importantly, all the features of the platform can be used absolutely free!

🌿 Eco Pulse - towards clean air, healthy life and green future!

🌐 Website: https://eco-pulsy-5of6.onrender.com/
🚀 Telegram channel: https://t.me/Eco_Pulse_AQI

It is commendable that the young generation creates useful projects for society using modern knowledge and technologies. This initiative of Abdivayitov Asadbek shows the innovative potential of young people and that they are not indifferent to environmental problems.

We wish Abdivayitov Asadbek great success in his future research and new projects!

🌎 Protecting nature means protecting our health!

text:
Özbekiston ziyolilari umumiy maqsad yölida birlaşmoqda

Mustaqil Özbekiston tarixida ilk bor 10-14-noyabr kunlari Qoraqalpoğiston Respublikasi, viloyatlar va Toşkent şahrida “Özbekiston ziyolilari kengaşi”ning hududiy yiğilişlari ötkaziladi.

Bu yiğilişlar “Yangi Özbekiston ziyolilari – milliy yuksaliş tayançi” şiori ostida ilm-fan, ta’lim, tibbiyot, adabiyot, madaniyat va boşqa sohalar vakillarini birlaştiradi.

Maqsad – ziyolilarning bilim va tajribasini yurt taraqqiyotiga yönaltiriş, joylardagi dolzarb masalalarni birgalikda muhokama qilib, amaliy takliflar işlab çiqiş.

Hududlarda bildirilgan taşabbuslar umumlaştirilib, Kengaşning respublika yiğilişida taqdim etiladi.

text_en:
Intellectuals of Uzbekistan are united for a common goal

For the first time in the history of independent Uzbekistan, on November 10-14, regional meetings of the "Council of Intellectuals of Uzbekistan" will be held in the Republic of Karakalpakstan, regions and the city of Tashkent.

These gatherings bring together representatives of science, education, medicine, literature, culture and other fields under the motto "New Uzbekistan intellectuals - the support of national progress".

The goal is to direct the knowledge and experience of intellectuals to the development of the country, to jointly discuss current local issues and develop practical proposals.

The initiatives announced in the regions will be summarized and presented at the republican meeting of the Council.

🟡 Mazkur festivalda maktabimiz o‘quvchilari bilan bir qatorda Qarshi shahridagi umumta’lim maktablari o‘quvchilari ham tashrif buyurib, ilm-fan va innovatsiyalar olamiga sayohat qildilar.
🧪Tadbir davomida yosh ixtirochilar tomonidan yaratilgan innovatsion loyihalar, ilmiy ishlanmalar, zamonaviy texnologiyalar hamda qiziqarli tajribalar namoyish etildi. Ishtirokchilar turli ilmiy tajribalar bilan yaqindan tanishib, o‘zlarini qiziqtirgan savollarga javob oldilar.

💠 Bunday tadbirlar yosh avlodning bilimga intilishi, izlanuvchanligi va innovatsion tafakkurini rivojlantirishga xizmat qiladi.

text_en:
✅NAUKA 0+" — FESTIVAL OF SCIENCE, INNOVATION AND DISCOVERY!

✅ Today, on November 3, the international science festival "NAUKA 0+" was held in the special boarding school No. 1 of Karshi city in an upbeat spirit.

🟡 At this festival, along with the students of our school, the students of general education schools in Karshi visited and traveled to the world of science and innovation.
🧪During the event, innovative projects created by young inventors, scientific developments, modern technologies and interesting experiments were demonstrated. The participants got acquainted with various scientific experiments and got answers to the questions they were interested in.
💠 The festival was important in increasing students' interest in science, developing creative and critical thinking skills, and inspiring new ideas and inventions.
💠 Such events serve to develop the desire for knowledge, inquisitiveness and innovative thinking of the young generation.

🚀Because today's curious reader is the author of tomorrow's great discoveries!
